detail.longDescription: I've been getting into robotics and kept losing track of which robot models are actually good and which ones you can run yourself. Scores are scattered across different benchmark sites, or even just papers, blogs and X posts. RoboFYI puts them in one place: - A leaderboard across the common benchmarks - A catalog of datasets - A catalog of hardware - Charts like progress of open vs closed models across every benchmark I'm keeping the data updated but I'm sure I've still missed a lot. Let me know what you'd like to see being added!
